utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a good turnout already—folks seem pretty eager to help. If you want, I can pass along the details I’ve heard so far.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Is that confirmed, or just a rumor? If you’ve got the details, I’d like to hear them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ve only heard it around the neighborhood so far, so I’d call it a strong rumor, not confirmed. But I can share the details I’ve picked up if you’d like.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m planning to swing by the repair drive later and see what still needs doing. If you want, I can check in with you after I’ve been there.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure, that’d be great. I might miss the update, so check in when you can.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll stop by later and then check in with you after I’ve been there.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m in—what do you need me to bring for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Could you bring a few work gloves and any spare screwdrivers you’ve got? That’d really help us out.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure thing — I’ll bring gloves and a couple screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard the details yet, but I’m glad there’s a repair drive. If you want, I can listen for updates and pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — that’d be a big help. I’ll share anything I hear about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course — just send me the details when you have them, and I’ll keep an ear out.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that—what time works around school pickup?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be great — after school pickup works best for me, maybe around 3:30?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 3:30 works for me too — I can swing by after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help, but I need a clear plan for the repair drive first. Tell me what needs doing and when, and I’ll stick to it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, sorry—I’ll get you a clear list. I’ll write down what needs fixing and the timing, then bring it to you.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, that works for me. Bring me the list when it’s ready, and I’ll follow the plan.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Pia, I’m passing the word around about the repair drive—want me to put your name down?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Maybe put me down as a maybe for now—I need to check my schedule and what time it starts.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll mark you down as a maybe and send you the time once I have it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces about the repair drive—what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: We’re lining up volunteers and sorting the most urgent fixes first, so things are moving along nicely. If you want, I can fill you in on how to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great, Rosa—I’d love to know how I can help.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m on it—what time does the repair drive start, and do we need to bring anything specific?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It starts at 9 a.m. in the community hall, and if you can, bring any tools you already have plus a notepad for parts lists.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it—I’ll plan for 9 a.m. at the community hall and bring my tools and a notepad.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help, but I’ll need to take it one small step at a time.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That works for me — I’ll swing by a bit later and help with whatever step you’re on.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. I’ll have the first step ready when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and bring over a few tools for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks, Gus. What time should I swing by?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: How about around 10 tomorrow morning?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping track of the repair drive now—where should I drop things off, and what’s the address again?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, just bring it by the community hall on Maple Street. I can grab the exact address if you want.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes please—I'd like the exact address so I can note it down correctly.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ve got a few tools I can lend for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus — I might take you up on that. I’ll let you know what we need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — happy to help whenever you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a little worried about the timing and who’s handling the drop-offs. If we can get the logistics pinned down, I’ll feel better about it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, I’d want that confirmed too — who’s doing the drop-offs, and what time are they set for?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Right, and it’d help to know whether we need one car or two. Once we have the schedule, I can relax a bit.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Jules — could you help spread the word and line up a few volunteers for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can spread the word and ask around for a few volunteers. If you’ve got any details like time, place, or tasks, send them my way and I’ll share them.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a running list of supplies we’ll need for the repair drive—just tell me what’s already covered, and I’ll fill in the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m sorry, I don’t have the list in front of me yet—what’s already covered?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No worries—I’ll keep the list open, and we can start with basics like gloves, tape, and a few tools. Just tell me when you know what’s already handled.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting started soon — folks are pulling together tools and donations already. If you want, I can help spread the word around the block.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That would be wonderful, Tess — thank you. I’m trying to keep things organized around the school schedule, so any help getting the word out would really go a long way.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll mention it to folks on the block and keep it tied to the school schedule so it’s easy to remember. Just let me know any details you want me to pass along.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Could you help me make a quick list of homes that need repairs and who’s able to lend a hand? I’ll handle the sign-up sheet and keep everything organized.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — I can make a quick list of the homes and note who can help. I’ll keep it brief and send it over soon.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — what kind of help do you need with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help sort tools and carry parts over. Just tell me where to start.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great — start by sorting the hand tools on the table, then I’ll point you to the parts boxes.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I'll spread the word about the repair drive right away.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn — I really appreciate that. I’ll keep an ear out for any updates.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You got it — I’ll let folks know and send updates your way if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m not sure yet—where’s the repair drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: It’s at the community hall on Maple Street, starting at 9 tomorrow morning. If you want, I can walk over with you.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, that helps — the community hall on Maple Street at 9 tomorrow. I’d appreciate the walk over.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana, do you want me to bring anything for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mina — could you bring a box of gloves and some masking tape? If you can, please double-check the tape is the blue kind.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — I’ll bring a box of gloves and blue masking tape.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and let folks know about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira — I really appreciate that. I’ll make sure everything’s ready for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No problem — I’ll spread the word while I’m out and about. Let me know if anything changes before then.
